newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Movement remains slow.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Movement remains slow.

text.p: Farmer sales of spring wheat remained very slow on Tuesday with both harvesting and planting of other crops keeping growers occupied.
Spring wheat bids were mixed while soft white wheat positions firmed.
White wheat movement was also slow.
"They (farmers) are finishing up winter wheat (seeding) right now and they are not selling a pound of anything," one Montana-based dealer said.
Further west in Minnesota the main distraction was provided by corn and soybeans.
"Farmers are getting into (harvesting) corn and soybeans and the wheat guys aren't doing much," one Minnesota based dealer said.
Spring wheat prices were mostly higher, aided by a stronger close on MGE futures.
